description: Org-wide Renovate preset for CiviLensSolutions. Repos extend this via local>CiviLensSolutions/.github:renovate-config.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One weekly PR per repo for all stable minor/patch bumps.
Auto-merge non-major bumps only in repos whose CI runs tests on pull requests. Free plan has no required checks, so Renovate itself waits for green checks instead of GitHub native auto-merge.
